name: aihub-codex-monitor
description: Generic relay request telemetry and pricing, with AIHub routing and balance enhancements for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Live Codex usage, relay pricing, latency, and optional AIHub routing.
interface.longDescription: Reads exact Codex rollout telemetry, estimates cost for any configured OpenAI-compatible relay, optionally observes Responses API traffic through a loopback proxy, and adds AIHub balance, provider health, group switching, and failover when the AIHub adapter is selected.
defaultPrompt: Start the live AIHub status line above the Codex composer.
Open the AIHub monitor at the bottom.
Show AIHub provider health and the active group.
Switch AIHub routing to economy mode.
